description: Creates a workspace HTTPS webhook. Requires `manage`. Use it for create_subscription. A taken name returns webhook_exists with its fullname. Use `signingSecret` to verify the `webhook-signature` header. The secret is shown only in this reply, and rotating it later with `POST /api/resources/{fullname}/signing-secret` replaces it for every receiver of that endpoint.
